page.layout: One printed engraved bookplate: a coat of arms with two putti and a crown above, and a scroll cartouche below holding three lines of text.
page.notes: Engraved ex libris of the Electoral Library of the Most Serene Dukes of both Bavarias. The engraving shows the Bavarian lozenge arms (blue and white checks) with two lions and an inescutcheon, topped by a ducal crown, held by two putti, with fruit garlands at the sides. Handwriting above the arms and the shelf mark at the top of the scan are not printed and are left out.
